what: The four sides of the decorative frame (vine-pattern bands) are cut out separately — the top side goes left to right, the right side top to bottom, the bottom side right to left, the left side bottom to top, each unwrapping from a clipped face and drawn in sequence clockwise — from 1s at .3s intervals, .6s power2.out per side

options.at: Time the first edge starts (sec), default 1
options.dur: Length for one edge to draw (seconds), default .6
options.ease: Curve (four numbers or GSAP name), default power2.out
options.on: If scroll, plays once when entering the screen (start, default top 80%) — requires ScrollTrigger. Default is right on attach
options.[data-fx-part=edge]: Four sides — data-key with top·right·bottom·left. Only the sides present are drawn
options.dur-side: Left/right side length (sec), same as the default dur
options.chain: 1 starts the next edge when the previous edge ends, instead of using a gap
